task.instruction: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.

final_answer:
**iOS 17 — key new features (per Apple's support article "About iOS 17 Updates" and Apple Newsroom)**

- **Phone:** Contact Posters (customized full-screen look for incoming/outgoing calls) and Live Voicemail with real-time on-device transcription you can pick up mid-message.
- **Messages:** All-in-one stickers experience with Live Stickers lifted from photos, audio message transcription, swipe-to-reply, better search filters, Check In (auto-notifies a contact when you arrive safely), and automatic verification-code cleanup.
- **FaceTime:** Leave audio or video messages, gesture-triggered Reactions (hearts, balloons, confetti), video effects, and FaceTime on Apple TV 4K using iPhone as the camera.
- **StandBy:** A new full-screen, glanceable display (clocks, photos, widgets, Live Activities) when iPhone is on its side and charging — with Night Mode and per-MagSafe-charger remembered views.
- **AirDrop/NameDrop:** Hold two iPhones together to swap contact info or start SharePlay; transfers can continue over the internet when you walk out of range (iOS 17.1).
- **Keyboard:** Transformer-model autocorrect, inline predictive text, easier revert of autocorrections, improved Dictation.
- **Widgets:** Interactive widgets you can tap to act on (Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy); iPhone widgets on Mac.
- **Safari/Passwords:** Profiles for work vs. personal browsing, locked Private Browsing with tracker blocking and link-tracking protection, password/passkey sharing groups.
- **Music/AirPlay:** SharePlay in the car, Crossfade, intelligent AirPlay device suggestions and automatic connections.
- **Journal app** (added in iOS 17.2), **Offline Maps**, **Siri** wake word "Siri" plus back-to-back requests, **Visual Look Up** in video, **Health** mental-wellbeing tools (State of Mind, assessments, Screen Distance), **AirTag/item sharing** in Find My, **Grocery Lists** in Reminders, and major **Accessibility** additions (Assistive Access, Live Speech, Personal Voice, Point and Speak).
- Later point releases added: Stolen Device Protection (17.3), Podcasts transcripts and new emoji (17.4), Apple News+ offline mode and cross-platform tracking alerts (17.5), plus ongoing security fixes through 17.7.x.

**Compatibility with iPhone 12 — yes, fully supported.**

Apple states iOS 17 is "a free software update that is available starting today for iPhone Xs and later." The iPhone 12 sits comfortably inside that range, and all four iPhone 12 variants are supported: **iPhone 12, iPhone 12 mini, iPhone 12 Pro, and iPhone 12 Pro Max** (the same list Apple publishes for the current iOS 18 download page, which includes iPhone 12).

A few feature caveats worth knowing for an iPhone 12 specifically:

- The **improved autocorrect, enhanced sentence corrections, and inline predictive text** are listed as "iPhone 12 and later" — so the iPhone 12 is the minimum model that gets them (iPhone 11 and earlier do not).
- **StandBy display-off timing options** require an Always-On display, i.e. iPhone 14 Pro/Pro Max or iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max — not available on iPhone 12.
- **Roadside Assistance via satellite** requires iPhone 14 or later; **Action button** and **Spatial video** require iPhone 15 Pro models; **Crash Detection** optimizations apply to iPhone 14/15 models.
- As always, Apple notes that some features may not be available in all regions, languages, or on all models — check apple.com/ios/feature-availability for the fine print.

So: iOS 17 runs on the iPhone 12 with essentially the full feature set, minus only the handful of capabilities tied to newer hardware (Always-On display, satellite, Action button).

judge.rationale: Final answer lists iOS 17 features and confirms iPhone 12 compatibility, supported by Apple page text showing features and “iPhone Xs and later.”

args.text: iOS 17 is compatible with these devices
